evidence.description: Police were called to a commercial premises in North Rochester, MN regarding a break-in (report 25-036092, Monday, March 31, 2025).
Examination of the point of entry showed the ATM found broken open when a community service officer responded to the burglary call.
Suspect left on a black e-bike.
